title: (Apple Silicon/M1 Mac) Inaccurate colors in the editor

posts.author: NoahB
posts.body:
While editing tilesets on my Macbook, I noticed a pretty noticeable discrepancy in the colors – they look much more saturated in the editor, but in-game they look normal.
Here is a comparison between Photoshop, the RPG Maker MZ editor and in-game:
As you can see, it's considerably more saturated in the editor, while it's in-game and Photoshop look the same. Originally, I thought it was a color profile issue in Photoshop, but a quick playtest showed me that the issue is isolated to just the editor.
While this isn't a huge issue, for me it's important to be able to see how different tiles work together in different maps at a glance without having to go into a playtest (where there may be screen tints and other visual effects)
I'll also add that this happens even in a fresh project.
Anyone else using an Apple Silicon Mac having this issue? Is there any way to fix it?
